review: 701.52a-1: two Kiddie Coasters are illegal in a constructed Attraction deck (717.2a); noted that the board is reachable in limited play (717.2b).

scenarios.title: Rolling to visit your Attractions visits each Attraction whose lit number equals the roll

setup.notes: The first Kiddie Coaster is variant A (lit 2, 3 and 6), the second is variant D (lit 3, 4 and 6). It is the beginning of A's precombat main phase, when A rolls to visit their Attractions. Kiddie Coaster's visit ability: creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. Two Attractions with the same English name are legal in a limited Attraction deck (717.2b).

decisions: At the beginning of A's precombat main phase, A rolls a six-sided die to visit their Attractions; the result is 2.
Both players pass; any triggered abilities resolve.

variants.label: roll_lit_on_one
variants.expected: 2 is lit only on the variant A Kiddie Coaster, so only it is visited and its visit ability triggers and resolves: Grizzly Bears gets +1/+0 until end of turn and is a 3/2.

variants.label: roll_not_lit
variants.expected: 5 is lit on neither Kiddie Coaster, so neither is visited and nothing triggers. Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

variants.label: roll_lit_on_both
variants.expected: 3 is lit on both Kiddie Coasters, so both are visited and both visit abilities trigger and resolve: Grizzly Bears gets +1/+0 twice and is a 4/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge rolls to visit automatically at the precombat main phase (PhaseHandler) only when the active player controls an Attraction; the die result must be forced.
